swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS54302DDCR uses SOT-23-6 (6-pin, DDC) while TPS54331DR uses SOIC-8 (8-pin, D); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (BOOT vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW). Soldering TPS54331DR onto a TPS54302DDCR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
HIGH RECTIFICATION DIFFERENCE: TPS54331DR is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS54302DDCR: 10 µH p.18 vs TPS54331DR: 6.8 µH p.16); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (TPS54302DDCR: 0.596 V p.5 vs TPS54331DR: 0.8 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
engineering_verdict: TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (BOOT vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW). Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency is 400 kHz (p.5) vs 570 kHz (p.6), rated current is 3000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 10 µH (p.18) vs 6.8 µH (p.16), and Iq is 45 µA (p.5) vs 110 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 118.9 vs 116.3 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
